info.title: Enterprise DMS API
info.description:
Enterprise DMS REST API. The backend owns this contract; clients (web today, desktop/mobile
later) consume it. Every protected operation is authorized server-side: authentication proves
who you are, **authorization decides what you may do with each folder/document**.

Errors always use `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id", "details"}}`.

post.summary: Record a sign-out; everywhere=true also invalidates every token issued so far
post.description:
The client discards its token on sign-out. Tokens are stateless, so a single token cannot
be revoked server-side; ``everywhere`` revokes all of this user's tokens issued before now
(the same mechanism admins use for suspected compromise).
